rules.name: Covenant
rules.text: Your gathering may only contain models with the Plasm keyword.

leaderTrait.name: Moonlight Flit
leaderTrait.text: After an enemy attack action and any subsequent pushes have been resolved against your leader you may push your leader up to 2″.

trait.name: Mournful Curse
trait.text: When this model is Shattered every model within 3″ suffers 2 damage.
